mostWorthwhile.text: Following glucose across the lining and tissue-fluid gap into blood made the route to the liver clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the blood route separately felt repetitive because the earlier surface already showed blood travelling toward the liver.

surprise.text: The blood-route goal remained unfinished even after the vein was added to the absorbing surface and both nutrients were shown travelling toward the liver.

arbitrary.text: The separate capillary-and-vein combination had a clear biological purpose, but needing it after the earlier connection felt like an unexplained game prerequisite.

continue.text: I might continue because seeing how structures support their jobs is useful, but the repeated route-building makes me less eager.
